description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

This natural spice inspires either love or dislike. Hidden deep in the mountains of Yunnan, it carries a fresh, lemony wild aroma with a gentle numbing tingle. Bright and refreshing, it cuts through richness and removes unwanted odors. Its crisp, untamed fragrance alone can bring an entire table of home-cooked dishes to life, making it the flavorful soul of everyday Yunnan cooking.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
